mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment(user_id, museum_id, object_id, content, source, audit_method, audit_status, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{museumId}, #{objectId}, #{content}, #{source}, #{auditMethod}, #{auditStatus}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE comment SET status = 0, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_id, c.user_id, c.museum_id, c.object_id, u.username, a.title as object_name, c.content, c.audit_status, c.status, c.created_at FROM comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN artifact a ON c.museum_id = a.museum_id AND c.object_id = a.object_id WHERE c.museum_id = #{museumId} AND c.object_id = #{objectId} AND c.audit_status = 1 AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
